tokens.name: window-bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every panel.

tokens.name: child-bg
tokens.usage: Panel and card surface, one step above window-bg.

tokens.name: menubar-bg

tokens.name: frame-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of inputs, slider tracks, combo boxes and unchecked boxes. No border: the fill alone marks the control. Flag: 1.3:1 dark, 1.1:1 light against child-bg, far below the 3:1 a control boundary needs.

tokens.usage: Input fill on hover.

tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb on hover.

tokens.name: scrollbar-grab-active
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb while dragged.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Default text on window-bg, child-bg and popup-bg.

tokens.name: title
tokens.usage: App title only. The amber of the logo. Flag: 4.0:1 on child-bg in light; passes only because the title is 20px semibold.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Section headings (Load Shapefile, Run Parameters, Score) on window-bg and child-bg.

tokens.name: subheading
tokens.usage: Labels above inputs, on window-bg and child-bg.

tokens.name: muted

tokens.name: secondary

tokens.name: accent-green

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet positive text on child-bg.

tokens.name: success-pale
tokens.usage: Success indicator text on child-bg.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Name of a score that is switched off, on child-bg. Flag: 3.2:1 dark, 4.1:1 light on child-bg, below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: disabled-deep
tokens.usage: Heavily disabled text on child-bg. Below 4.5:1 by design; never use for text a person must read. Flag: 2.2:1 dark, 3.1:1 light.

tokens.name: disabled-subtle
tokens.usage: Disabled label that should still be legible, on child-bg. Flag: 3.9:1 dark, 3.6:1 light on child-bg, below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: dialog-muted
tokens.usage: Hints and file paths inside dialogs, on popup-bg. Flag: 4.2:1 on popup-bg in light, below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text on window-bg, child-bg and popup-bg. Flag: 4.4:1 on child-bg in dark, just under 4.5:1.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text on window-bg, child-bg and popup-bg. Flag: 4.1:1 on child-bg in light, below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Confirmation text on window-bg, child-bg and popup-bg.
